C09 and C21 share much of the same contemporary resignation-letter structure, but their language and internal organization are less closely aligned with the child.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"In accepting your resignation as Director of the Bureau of the Budget, effective January 20, 1961, I wish to tall you what a superb job you have done.","parent_excerpt":"I am accepting your resignation, effective January 20, 1961, and in so doing I wish to pay tribute to your dedication and management skill","explanation":"Nearly identical operative resignation language, including the same effective date, embedded in an opening assessment of administrative performance."},{"child_excerpt":"Your report outlines these improvements--the work of the Office of Financial Management in the Bureau of the Budget, improved accounting systems, training institutes, important changes in the annual budget process, adoption of Hoover Commission recommendations, new automatic data processing.","parent_excerpt":"Particularly do I wish to thank you for your fine report of achievements of your Department. You have introduced outstanding improvements in the postal service: the Department's archaic accounting system has been corrected; a new Bureau of Personnel...; an aggressive building and leasing program...; a long-range program explores avenues for greater mechanization","explanation":"Both pivot to the departing official's report and present a detailed catalogue of administrative improvements, including accounting reform and modernization or mechanization."},{"child_excerpt":"As you reenter private life, please accept my deep appreciation and gratitude. Good luck on your safari and best wishes for a future of good health and happiness.","parent_excerpt":"I thank you for these services to the Nation and for your friendship over these past eight years. You have my very best wishes for the future as you return to private life. May good health and happiness be yours in the years ahead.","explanation":"The closing combines gratitude, return to private life, and wishes for future health and happiness in substantially the same order and language."}]}
